services.value: Environmental analytical services including PFAS, microbiology (bacteria in drinking water), metals by ICP/ICP-MS, BTEX and MTBE by GCMS, PAH by GC/MS, pesticide/PCB/herbicide analysis by GC, TCLP and SPLP analysis, TPH (TX1005/1006) by GC/MS, semi-volatile and volatile organics by GC/MS, and TRRP.
